title: Phase transition for the smallest eigenvalue of high-dimensional sample correlation matrices
summary: We study the smallest nonzero eigenvalue of the sample correlation matrix $\mathbf{R}_n$ formed from a $p_n \times n$ data matrix with i.i.d. real entries $ξ$ of mean zero and unit variance, in the high-dimensional regime $p_n / n \to φ\in (0, \infty) \setminus \{1\}$. In the tall regime $φ> 1$, we prove almost-sure convergence of $λ_n (\mathbf{R}_n)$ to the lower Marčenko--Pastur edge $λ_- = (1 - \sqrtφ)^2$ without additional moment assumptions.
